description.ar: صمم نظام شات real-time زي WhatsApp مع group chats
description.en: Design a real-time chat system like WhatsApp with group chats

problemStatement.ar: عايزينك تصمم نظام شات real-time زي WhatsApp. الفيتشرز المطلوبة: 1:1 chat، group chats (لحد 500 عضو)، online/offline presence، delivery receipts (sent/delivered/read)، offline message delivery، والـ push notifications. الرسائل لازم تكون ordered وما تتفقدش.
problemStatement.en: Design a real-time chat system like WhatsApp. Required features: 1:1 chat, group chats (up to 500 members), online/offline presence, delivery receipts (sent/delivered/read), offline message delivery, and push notifications. Messages must be ordered and not lost.

prompt.ar: قبل ما تصمم، اسأل الأسئلة التوضيحية اللي محتاجها، واعمل حسبة سريعة للأرقام: messages/sec، storage، concurrent connections.
prompt.en: Before designing, ask clarifying questions and do quick estimation: messages/sec, storage, concurrent connections.

text.ar: سألت عن الـ scope: end-to-end encryption، media messages، typing indicators
text.en: Asked about scope: end-to-end encryption, media messages, typing indicators

ar.why: الـ scope بيحدد الـ complexity. E2EE مثلا بيغير الـ architecture كلها.
ar.how: اسأل: هل محتاجين encryption? Media support? Typing indicators? Read receipts?
ar.tradeoffs: كل feature إضافية بتزود الـ complexity والـ latency.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: E2EE لكل الرسائل. Slack: E2EE اختياري.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تبدأ تصمم من غير ما تعرف الـ scope بالظبط.

en.why: Scope determines complexity. E2EE for example changes the entire architecture.
en.how: Ask: Do we need encryption? Media support? Typing indicators? Read receipts?
en.tradeoffs: Each additional feature adds complexity and latency.
en.examples: WhatsApp: E2EE for all messages. Slack: E2EE optional.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Starting to design without knowing exact scope.

text.ar: حسبت messages/sec: 50B/day = ~600K/sec
text.en: Calculated messages/sec: 50B/day = ~600K/sec

ar.why: الـ throughput بيحدد عدد الـ servers والـ architecture.
ar.how: 50 billion / 86400 seconds = 578K/sec. Peak = 2-3x = ~1.5M/sec.
ar.tradeoffs: الـ peak مهم جدا، مش الـ average بس.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: 100B messages/day = ~1.2M/sec average.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تحسب الـ average بس وتنسى الـ peak.

en.why: Throughput determines number of servers and architecture.
en.how: 50 billion / 86400 seconds = 578K/sec. Peak = 2-3x = ~1.5M/sec.
en.tradeoffs: Peak is very important, not just average.
en.examples: WhatsApp: 100B messages/day = ~1.2M/sec average.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Calculating only average, forgetting peak.

text.ar: حسبت storage: 50B messages × 1KB avg = 50TB/day
text.en: Calculated storage: 50B messages × 1KB avg = 50TB/day

ar.why: الـ storage بيحدد الـ database choice والـ retention policy.
ar.how: 50B × 1KB = 50TB/day. سنة = 18PB. بس compression = ~6PB.
ar.tradeoffs: الـ retention policy بتأثر كتير. Media أكبر بكتير.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: messages stored حتى delivery. Media: 30 days.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تنسى الـ media storage اللي أكبر بـ 10-100x.

en.why: Storage determines database choice and retention policy.
en.how: 50B × 1KB = 50TB/day. Year = 18PB. But with compression = ~6PB.
en.tradeoffs: Retention policy affects a lot. Media is much bigger.
en.examples: WhatsApp: messages stored until delivery. Media: 30 days.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Forgetting media storage which is 10-100x larger.

text.ar: حسبت concurrent connections: 500M DAU × 30% concurrent = 150M
text.en: Calculated concurrent connections: 500M DAU × 30% concurrent = 150M

ar.why: WebSocket connections بتستهلك memory وfile descriptors.
ar.how: 500M DAU × 30% online = 150M connections. كل connection ~10KB memory.
ar.tradeoffs: أكتر connections = أكتر servers. بس أقل polling.
ar.examples: 150M connections / 100K per server = 1500 connection servers.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تقلل الـ concurrent percentage أوي.

en.why: WebSocket connections consume memory and file descriptors.
en.how: 500M DAU × 30% online = 150M connections. Each connection ~10KB memory.
en.tradeoffs: More connections = more servers. But less polling.
en.examples: 150M connections / 100K per server = 1500 connection servers.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Underestimating concurrent percentage.

prompt.ar: صمم الـ high-level architecture: clients، WebSocket servers، message routing، storage، presence، notifications.
prompt.en: Design the high-level architecture: clients, WebSocket servers, message routing, storage, presence, notifications.

text.ar: 📊 الرسم التخطيطي للـ architecture
text.en: 📊 Architecture diagram

ar.why: الرسم بيوضح الـ flow والـ components بشكل visual.
ar.how: ارسم الـ clients، WebSocket servers، routing، message queue، storage، presence service.
ar.tradeoffs: الرسم المبسط أحسن من التفصيلي في المقابلة.
ar.examples: Client → LB → WS Server → Router → Queue → Storage / Push.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: ترسم كل حاجة في رسم واحد معقد.

en.why: Diagram visualizes flow and components clearly.
en.how: Draw clients, WebSocket servers, routing, message queue, storage, presence service.
en.tradeoffs: Simple diagram is better than detailed one in interviews.
en.examples: Client → LB → WS Server → Router → Queue → Storage / Push.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Drawing everything in one complex diagram.

text.ar: WebSocket connection layer: persistent connections مع heartbeat
text.en: WebSocket connection layer: persistent connections with heartbeat

ar.why: HTTP polling غير كفء. WebSocket بيدي real-time delivery.
ar.how: Client يفتح WebSocket connection. Heartbeat كل 30 seconds.
ar.tradeoffs: WebSocket: real-time بس stateful. HTTP: simpler بس latency.
ar.examples: WhatsApp, Slack, Discord كلهم بيستخدموا WebSocket.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: HTTP polling، الـ latency عالية والـ load كبير.

en.why: HTTP polling is inefficient. WebSocket provides real-time delivery.
en.how: Client opens WebSocket connection. Heartbeat every 30 seconds.
en.tradeoffs: WebSocket: real-time but stateful. HTTP: simpler but latency.
en.examples: WhatsApp, Slack, Discord all use WebSocket.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: HTTP polling, high latency and big load.

text.ar: Message routing: معرفة أي connection server الـ recipient عليه
text.en: Message routing: knowing which connection server the recipient is on

ar.why: الـ sender والـ recipient على servers مختلفة. لازم routing.
ar.how: User-to-server mapping في Redis. Message router يبحث ويرسل.
ar.tradeoffs: Central router: simple بس bottleneck. Distributed: complex بس scalable.
ar.examples: Redis cluster للـ mapping. Consistent hashing للـ distribution.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: central single router، point of failure.

en.why: Sender and recipient are on different servers. Need routing.
en.how: User-to-server mapping in Redis. Message router looks up and sends.
en.tradeoffs: Central router: simple but bottleneck. Distributed: complex but scalable.
en.examples: Redis cluster for mapping. Consistent hashing for distribution.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Central single router, point of failure.

text.ar: Message queue للـ async delivery والـ persistence
text.en: Message queue for async delivery and persistence

ar.why: لو الـ recipient offline، الرسالة لازم تتخزن وتتبعت لما يرجع.
ar.how: Kafka per-user topic أو per-conversation. Consumer = device connection.
ar.tradeoffs: Per-user: simpler routing. Per-conversation: better for groups.
ar.examples: Kafka مع millions of partitions. أو Cassandra-based message store.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: single queue لكل الرسائل، bottleneck.

en.why: If recipient is offline, message must be stored and sent when they return.
en.how: Kafka per-user topic or per-conversation. Consumer = device connection.
en.tradeoffs: Per-user: simpler routing. Per-conversation: better for groups.
en.examples: Kafka with millions of partitions. Or Cassandra-based message store.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Single queue for all messages, bottleneck.

text.ar: Group fan-out: write-time vs read-time fan-out
text.en: Group fan-out: write-time vs read-time fan-out

ar.why: Group message محتاج يوصل لـ 500 member. إزاي?
ar.how: Write-time: copy الرسالة لكل inbox (500 writes). Read-time: single write، كل member يقرا.
ar.tradeoffs: Write-time: سريع للقراءة بس كتابة كتير. Read-time: كتابة أقل بس قراءة أبطأ.
ar.examples: Small groups (< 100): write-time. Large groups: read-time أو hybrid.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: write-time fan-out لـ groups كبيرة، الـ write amplification ضخم.

en.why: Group message needs to reach 500 members. How?
en.how: Write-time: copy message to each inbox (500 writes). Read-time: single write, each member reads.
en.tradeoffs: Write-time: fast reads but many writes. Read-time: fewer writes but slower reads.
en.examples: Small groups (< 100): write-time. Large groups: read-time or hybrid.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Write-time fan-out for large groups, write amplification is huge.

text.ar: Delivery receipts: sent، delivered، read flow
text.en: Delivery receipts: sent, delivered, read flow

ar.why: Users expect to know if message was delivered and read.
ar.how: Sent: server acks. Delivered: device acks. Read: user opens conversation.
ar.tradeoffs: Each receipt = additional message. Batching helps.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: single tick (sent)، double tick (delivered)، blue ticks (read).
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: receipts synchronous، بيبطّئ الـ sending.

en.why: Users expect to know if message was delivered and read.
en.how: Sent: server acks. Delivered: device acks. Read: user opens conversation.
en.tradeoffs: Each receipt = additional message. Batching helps.
en.examples: WhatsApp: single tick (sent), double tick (delivered), blue ticks (read).
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Synchronous receipts slow down sending.

text.ar: Online/offline presence: heartbeat mechanism مع Redis
text.en: Online/offline presence: heartbeat mechanism with Redis

ar.why: Users want to see who is online.
ar.how: Heartbeat كل 30 sec يحدث TTL في Redis. No heartbeat = offline.
ar.tradeoffs: Shorter heartbeat: more accurate بس more load. Longer: less accurate.
ar.examples: Redis SETEX with 60 sec TTL. Heartbeat كل 30 sec.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: polling للـ presence، load عالي جدا.

en.why: Users want to see who is online.
en.how: Heartbeat every 30 sec updates TTL in Redis. No heartbeat = offline.
en.tradeoffs: Shorter heartbeat: more accurate but more load. Longer: less accurate.
en.examples: Redis SETEX with 60 sec TTL. Heartbeat every 30 sec.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Polling for presence, very high load.

text.ar: Push notifications للـ offline users
text.en: Push notifications for offline users

ar.why: لو الـ user offline، لازم notification يوصله.
ar.how: If user offline → push to FCM/APNs. Store device tokens.
ar.tradeoffs: Push has latency (100ms-seconds). Not real-time.
ar.examples: FCM for Android, APNs for iOS. Rate limiting مهم.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: push لكل message، الـ user بيتضايق من الـ spam.

en.why: If user is offline, notification must reach them.
en.how: If user offline → push to FCM/APNs. Store device tokens.
en.tradeoffs: Push has latency (100ms-seconds). Not real-time.
en.examples: FCM for Android, APNs for iOS. Rate limiting is important.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Push for every message, user annoyed by spam.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale النظام لـ 500M users و150M concurrent connections؟
prompt.en: How do you scale the system for 500M users and 150M concurrent connections?

text.ar: WebSocket server scaling: horizontal مع sticky sessions
text.en: WebSocket server scaling: horizontal with sticky sessions

ar.why: Connection واحد = server واحد. محتاج sticky.
ar.how: Load balancer يوجه user لنفس الـ server (IP hash أو cookie).
ar.tradeoffs: Sticky: simpler reconnect بس uneven load ممكن.
ar.examples: HAProxy مع IP hash. أو application-level routing.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: round-robin بدون sticky، الـ user بيفقد connection.

en.why: One connection = one server. Need sticky.
en.how: Load balancer routes user to same server (IP hash or cookie).
en.tradeoffs: Sticky: simpler reconnect but possible uneven load.
en.examples: HAProxy with IP hash. Or application-level routing.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Round-robin without sticky, user loses connection.

text.ar: Message storage sharding: by user_id أو conversation_id
text.en: Message storage sharding: by user_id or conversation_id

ar.why: 50TB/day لا يمكن يتخزن في single database.
ar.how: Shard by conversation_id. All messages للـ conversation في نفس الـ shard.
ar.tradeoffs: By user: سهل للـ inbox. By conversation: سهل للـ chat history.
ar.examples: Cassandra مع partition key = conversation_id.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: shard by message_id، الـ conversation queries بطيئة.

en.why: 50TB/day cannot be stored in single database.
en.how: Shard by conversation_id. All messages for conversation in same shard.
en.tradeoffs: By user: easy for inbox. By conversation: easy for chat history.
en.examples: Cassandra with partition key = conversation_id.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Shard by message_id, conversation queries slow.

text.ar: Presence service scaling: Redis cluster مع sharding by user_id
text.en: Presence service scaling: Redis cluster with sharding by user_id

ar.why: Single Redis لا يستحمل 500M users.
ar.how: Redis cluster مع sharding by user_id. Each shard handles subset.
ar.tradeoffs: More shards = more complexity بس better performance.
ar.examples: Redis cluster مع 100 shards. 5M users per shard.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: single Redis instance، memory overflow.

en.why: Single Redis cannot handle 500M users.
en.how: Redis cluster with sharding by user_id. Each shard handles subset.
en.tradeoffs: More shards = more complexity but better performance.
en.examples: Redis cluster with 100 shards. 5M users per shard.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Single Redis instance, memory overflow.

text.ar: Group membership caching: local cache مع invalidation
text.en: Group membership caching: local cache with invalidation

ar.why: كل message في group محتاج list الـ members. DB query كل مرة بطيء.
ar.how: Cache group members locally. Invalidate عند member join/leave.
ar.tradeoffs: Stale cache ممكن يوصل message لـ ex-member لثواني.
ar.examples: Local Caffeine cache مع 60 sec TTL. Pub/sub للـ invalidation.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: no cache، DB overload مع كل message.

en.why: Every message in group needs member list. DB query each time is slow.
en.how: Cache group members locally. Invalidate on member join/leave.
en.tradeoffs: Stale cache might send message to ex-member for seconds.
en.examples: Local Caffeine cache with 60 sec TTL. Pub/sub for invalidation.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: No cache, DB overload with every message.

prompt.ar: إيه الـ metrics اللي هتراقبها؟ وإزاي تعرف إن في مشكلة؟
prompt.en: What metrics would you monitor? How do you know when there is a problem?

text.ar: End-to-end message latency: sent → delivered
text.en: End-to-end message latency: sent → delivered

ar.why: Users feel slow chat. E2E latency أهم من server latency.
ar.how: Timestamp at send، timestamp at delivery. p50، p99، p999.
ar.tradeoffs: الـ clock drift بين devices ممكن يأثر.
ar.examples: Target: p99 < 300ms for online recipients.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تقيس server latency بس، الـ network latency مختفي.

en.why: Users feel slow chat. E2E latency more important than server latency.
en.how: Timestamp at send, timestamp at delivery. p50, p99, p999.
en.tradeoffs: Clock drift between devices might affect.
en.examples: Target: p99 < 300ms for online recipients.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Measuring only server latency, network latency hidden.

text.ar: WebSocket connection count وreconnection rate
text.en: WebSocket connection count and reconnection rate

ar.why: High reconnection rate = network issues أو server problems.
ar.how: Count active connections. Track reconnects per minute.
ar.tradeoffs: Mobile: higher reconnection normal. Desktop: should be stable.
ar.examples: Alert: reconnection rate > 5% per minute.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: متابعش الـ reconnections، الـ users بيعانوا.

en.why: High reconnection rate = network issues or server problems.
en.how: Count active connections. Track reconnects per minute.
en.tradeoffs: Mobile: higher reconnection normal. Desktop: should be stable.
en.examples: Alert: reconnection rate > 5% per minute.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Not tracking reconnections, users suffer.

text.ar: Message queue depth وprocessing lag
text.en: Message queue depth and processing lag

ar.why: لو الـ queue بتتراكم، messages بتتأخر.
ar.how: Kafka consumer lag metric. Alert لما lag > 10 seconds.
ar.tradeoffs: Some lag acceptable during spikes. Sustained lag = problem.
ar.examples: Kafka lag monitoring. Burrow أو built-in metrics.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: متابعش الـ lag، الرسائل بتتأخر من غير ما تعرف.

en.why: If queue is backing up, messages are delayed.
en.how: Kafka consumer lag metric. Alert when lag > 10 seconds.
en.tradeoffs: Some lag acceptable during spikes. Sustained lag = problem.
en.examples: Kafka lag monitoring. Burrow or built-in metrics.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Not tracking lag, messages delayed without knowing.

text.ar: Delivery success rate: messages delivered vs sent
text.en: Delivery success rate: messages delivered vs sent

ar.why: لو messages مش بتوصل، الـ users هيشتكوا.
ar.how: sent_count vs delivered_count. Success rate = delivered / sent.
ar.tradeoffs: Offline users affect rate. Track online vs offline separately.
ar.examples: Target: 99.9% delivery for online users. 100% eventual delivery.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تعتبر undelivered (offline) كـ failure.

en.why: If messages not delivered, users will complain.
en.how: sent_count vs delivered_count. Success rate = delivered / sent.
en.tradeoffs: Offline users affect rate. Track online vs offline separately.
en.examples: Target: 99.9% delivery for online users. 100% eventual delivery.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Treating undelivered (offline) as failure.

prompt.ar: إيه الأماكن اللي متوقع تبقى عنق زجاجة، وإزاي تحلها؟
prompt.en: What are the expected bottlenecks and how do you solve them?

text.ar: WebSocket connection limit per server: kernel tuning وC10M problem
text.en: WebSocket connection limit per server: kernel tuning and C10M problem

ar.why: Default Linux limits: ~65K connections. محتاج tuning.
ar.how: Increase file descriptors، ephemeral ports، memory. Event-driven server (epoll).
ar.tradeoffs: High connections = high memory. بس أقل servers.
ar.examples: Single server: 100K-500K connections مع tuning.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: default settings، الـ server بيرفض connections.

en.why: Default Linux limits: ~65K connections. Need tuning.
en.how: Increase file descriptors, ephemeral ports, memory. Event-driven server (epoll).
en.tradeoffs: High connections = high memory. But fewer servers.
en.examples: Single server: 100K-500K connections with tuning.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Default settings, server rejects connections.

text.ar: Group fan-out for large groups: batching وrate limiting
text.en: Group fan-out for large groups: batching and rate limiting

ar.why: Group مع 500 member، كل message = 500 delivery.
ar.how: Batch fan-out. Rate limit messages per group. Use read-time fan-out.
ar.tradeoffs: Batching adds latency. بس يقلل الـ load.
ar.examples: 500 member group: batch 50 deliveries at a time.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: immediate fan-out لكل message، thundering herd.

en.why: Group with 500 members, each message = 500 deliveries.
en.how: Batch fan-out. Rate limit messages per group. Use read-time fan-out.
en.tradeoffs: Batching adds latency. But reduces load.
en.examples: 500 member group: batch 50 deliveries at a time.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Immediate fan-out for each message, thundering herd.

text.ar: Presence updates storm: pub/sub batching
text.en: Presence updates storm: pub/sub batching

ar.why: لو user عنده 500 contact، كل presence change = 500 notifications.
ar.how: Batch presence updates. Send every 5 seconds instead of immediately.
ar.tradeoffs: Stale presence for few seconds. بس acceptable.
ar.examples: User comes online → wait 5 sec → batch notify all contacts.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: immediate presence broadcast، massive load spike.

en.why: If user has 500 contacts, each presence change = 500 notifications.
en.how: Batch presence updates. Send every 5 seconds instead of immediately.
en.tradeoffs: Stale presence for few seconds. But acceptable.
en.examples: User comes online → wait 5 sec → batch notify all contacts.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Immediate presence broadcast, massive load spike.

text.ar: Message ordering: per-conversation sequence numbers
text.en: Message ordering: per-conversation sequence numbers

ar.why: Messages لازم تظهر بالترتيب. Network delays ممكن تعكس.
ar.how: Server assigns sequence number per conversation. Client reorders.
ar.tradeoffs: Waiting for missing sequence adds latency.
ar.examples: Conversation sequence: 1، 2، 3... Client reorders if 3 arrives before 2.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: timestamp-based ordering، clock drift بيخرب الترتيب.

en.why: Messages must appear in order. Network delays can reverse.
en.how: Server assigns sequence number per conversation. Client reorders.
en.tradeoffs: Waiting for missing sequence adds latency.
en.examples: Conversation sequence: 1, 2, 3... Client reorders if 3 arrives before 2.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Timestamp-based ordering, clock drift breaks order.

prompt.ar: إيه الـ trade-offs الرئيسية اللي عملتها وليه؟
prompt.en: What are the main trade-offs you made and why?

text.ar: Consistency vs Availability: eventual consistency للـ messages
text.en: Consistency vs Availability: eventual consistency for messages

ar.why: Chat يتحمل eventual consistency. الـ user يستنى ثواني.
ar.how: Async replication. Message might not appear immediately in all views.
ar.tradeoffs: Strong consistency: slower، higher latency. Eventual: faster.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: eventual. Message sent، might take seconds to appear everywhere.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: strong consistency لكل حاجة، الـ latency عالية.

en.why: Chat tolerates eventual consistency. User waits seconds.
en.how: Async replication. Message might not appear immediately in all views.
en.tradeoffs: Strong consistency: slower, higher latency. Eventual: faster.
en.examples: WhatsApp: eventual. Message sent, might take seconds to appear everywhere.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Strong consistency for everything, high latency.

text.ar: Storage cost vs Query speed: denormalization
text.en: Storage cost vs Query speed: denormalization

ar.why: Normalized data = complex joins. Denormalized = fast reads.
ar.how: Store message in both sender and recipient inbox. Duplicate data.
ar.tradeoffs: More storage (2x+) بس faster reads.
ar.examples: Message stored in sender outbox + recipient inbox.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: normalized schema، slow queries، high latency.

en.why: Normalized data = complex joins. Denormalized = fast reads.
en.how: Store message in both sender and recipient inbox. Duplicate data.
en.tradeoffs: More storage (2x+) but faster reads.
en.examples: Message stored in sender outbox + recipient inbox.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Normalized schema, slow queries, high latency.

text.ar: Real-time vs Push: WebSocket + fallback to push
text.en: Real-time vs Push: WebSocket + fallback to push

ar.why: WebSocket is real-time بس battery-intensive on mobile.
ar.how: WebSocket when app open. Push when app closed/background.
ar.tradeoffs: Push: 100ms-seconds latency. WebSocket: immediate.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: WebSocket foreground، push background.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: WebSocket-only، الـ battery بتفضى.

en.why: WebSocket is real-time but battery-intensive on mobile.
en.how: WebSocket when app open. Push when app closed/background.
en.tradeoffs: Push: 100ms-seconds latency. WebSocket: immediate.
en.examples: WhatsApp: WebSocket foreground, push background.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: WebSocket-only, battery drains.

prompt.en: How would you add message search to the system?

text.ar: Elasticsearch للـ full-text search
text.en: Elasticsearch for full-text search

ar.why: DB LIKE queries بطيئة جدا لـ text search.
ar.how: Index messages في Elasticsearch. Query بيرجع message IDs.
ar.tradeoffs: Additional infrastructure بس fast search.
ar.examples: ES index per user. Search within own messages only.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: search في الـ main DB، slow و resource-intensive.

en.why: DB LIKE queries very slow for text search.
en.how: Index messages in Elasticsearch. Query returns message IDs.
en.tradeoffs: Additional infrastructure but fast search.
en.examples: ES index per user. Search within own messages only.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Search in main DB, slow and resource-intensive.

text.ar: Search index partitioning: per-user أو per-conversation
text.en: Search index partitioning: per-user or per-conversation

ar.why: 50B messages مش هتتحط في index واحد.
ar.how: Partition by user_id. User searches their own messages only.
ar.tradeoffs: Per-user: simple. Cross-user search needs aggregation.
ar.examples: ES index: messages_user_123. Each user has own index.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: global search index، huge و slow.

en.why: 50B messages cannot fit in one index.
en.how: Partition by user_id. User searches their own messages only.
en.tradeoffs: Per-user: simple. Cross-user search needs aggregation.
en.examples: ES index: messages_user_123. Each user has own index.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Global search index, huge and slow.

text.ar: Async indexing: eventual consistency للـ search
text.en: Async indexing: eventual consistency for search

ar.why: Sync indexing يبطّئ message delivery.
ar.how: Message sent → async job → index في ES. Lag = seconds.
ar.tradeoffs: New message might not be searchable immediately.
ar.examples: Kafka consumer يقرا messages ويـ index في ES.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: sync indexing في الـ critical path، high latency.

en.why: Sync indexing slows message delivery.
en.how: Message sent → async job → index in ES. Lag = seconds.
en.tradeoffs: New message might not be searchable immediately.
en.examples: Kafka consumer reads messages and indexes in ES.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Sync indexing in critical path, high latency.

prompt.en: How would you add typing indicators (the "typing..." status)?

text.ar: Ephemeral messages: لا تتخزن، direct routing
text.en: Ephemeral messages: not stored, direct routing

ar.why: Typing events مش محتاج persistence. Fire and forget.
ar.how: Direct WebSocket message. No DB write. No queue.
ar.tradeoffs: Might be lost if network issue. بس acceptable.
ar.examples: User types → server broadcasts → recipients see "typing..."
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تخزن typing events، unnecessary storage.

en.why: Typing events do not need persistence. Fire and forget.
en.how: Direct WebSocket message. No DB write. No queue.
en.tradeoffs: Might be lost if network issue. But acceptable.
en.examples: User types → server broadcasts → recipients see "typing..."
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Storing typing events, unnecessary storage.

text.ar: Throttling: send typing event max every 2-3 seconds
text.en: Throttling: send typing event max every 2-3 seconds

ar.why: كل keystroke = typing event? Too much traffic.
ar.how: Client throttles. Send typing start، then nothing for 3 sec.
ar.tradeoffs: Less real-time بس much less traffic.
ar.examples: User types → send "typing"، wait 3 sec، send again if still typing.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: typing event لكل keystroke، massive traffic.

en.why: Every keystroke = typing event? Too much traffic.
en.how: Client throttles. Send typing start, then nothing for 3 sec.
en.tradeoffs: Less real-time but much less traffic.
en.examples: User types → send "typing", wait 3 sec, send again if still typing.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Typing event for every keystroke, massive traffic.

text.ar: Timeout: auto-clear typing indicator بعد 5 seconds
text.en: Timeout: auto-clear typing indicator after 5 seconds

ar.why: لو الـ user بطّل يكتب، الـ "typing..." لازم يختفي.
ar.how: Client sets 5 sec timeout. No new typing event = clear indicator.
ar.tradeoffs: Simple implementation. No explicit "stopped typing" message needed.
ar.examples: Show "typing..."، start 5 sec timer، hide if no new event.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: waiting for explicit "stopped" event، indicator stays forever.

en.why: If user stopped typing, "typing..." must disappear.
en.how: Client sets 5 sec timeout. No new typing event = clear indicator.
en.tradeoffs: Simple implementation. No explicit "stopped typing" message needed.
en.examples: Show "typing...", start 5 sec timer, hide if no new event.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Waiting for explicit "stopped" event, indicator stays forever.

prompt.en: How would you add end-to-end encryption?

text.ar: Signal Protocol: Double Ratchet for forward secrecy
text.en: Signal Protocol: Double Ratchet for forward secrecy

ar.why: Standard E2EE protocol. Used by WhatsApp، Signal، etc.
ar.how: Each user has identity key pair. Session keys for each conversation.
ar.tradeoffs: Complex key management. بس proven secure.
ar.examples: WhatsApp uses Signal Protocol. Open source implementation available.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: invent own encryption protocol، security vulnerabilities.

en.why: Standard E2EE protocol. Used by WhatsApp, Signal, etc.
en.how: Each user has identity key pair. Session keys for each conversation.
en.tradeoffs: Complex key management. But proven secure.
en.examples: WhatsApp uses Signal Protocol. Open source implementation available.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Inventing own encryption protocol, security vulnerabilities.

text.ar: Key distribution: server as message relay، not key holder
text.en: Key distribution: server as message relay, not key holder

ar.why: Server should not be able to decrypt messages.
ar.how: Public keys exchanged via server. Server never sees private keys.
ar.tradeoffs: Server cannot do content moderation. Trust device security.
ar.examples: User A requests User B public key → server returns → A encrypts.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: server holds keys، E2EE is broken.

en.why: Server should not be able to decrypt messages.
en.how: Public keys exchanged via server. Server never sees private keys.
en.tradeoffs: Server cannot do content moderation. Trust device security.
en.examples: User A requests User B public key → server returns → A encrypts.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Server holds keys, E2EE is broken.

text.ar: Group E2EE: sender encrypts for each member
text.en: Group E2EE: sender encrypts for each member

ar.why: Group message محتاج يتشفر لكل recipient.
ar.how: Sender encrypts message with each member public key. Or use group session key.
ar.tradeoffs: Per-member: more computation. Group key: key rotation complexity.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: Sender Keys protocol for groups. Single encrypt، all decrypt.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: single group key بدون rotation، key compromise affects all history.

en.why: Group message needs to be encrypted for each recipient.
en.how: Sender encrypts message with each member public key. Or use group session key.
en.tradeoffs: Per-member: more computation. Group key: key rotation complexity.
en.examples: WhatsApp: Sender Keys protocol for groups. Single encrypt, all decrypt.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Single group key without rotation, key compromise affects all history.

text.ar: WebSocket servers: 1500 servers × $500/month = $750K/month
text.en: WebSocket servers: 1500 servers × $500/month = $750K/month

ar.why: 150M connections / 100K per server = 1500 servers.
ar.how: c5.4xlarge ($500/month) مع 100K connections each.
ar.tradeoffs: Reserved instances: 40% cheaper. Spot: risky for stateful.
ar.examples: AWS: 1500 × c5.4xlarge reserved = ~$450K/month.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: on-demand pricing، الـ cost ضعف.

en.why: 150M connections / 100K per server = 1500 servers.
en.how: c5.4xlarge ($500/month) with 100K connections each.
en.tradeoffs: Reserved instances: 40% cheaper. Spot: risky for stateful.
en.examples: AWS: 1500 × c5.4xlarge reserved = ~$450K/month.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: On-demand pricing, cost doubles.

text.ar: Storage: 50TB/day × 30 days = 1.5PB = ~$35K/month
text.en: Storage: 50TB/day × 30 days = 1.5PB = ~$35K/month

ar.why: Messages stored for 30 days average.
ar.how: S3 Standard: $23/TB/month. 1500TB × $23 = $35K.
ar.tradeoffs: Tiering to Glacier: 80% cheaper for old messages.
ar.examples: Hot (7 days): S3. Warm (30 days): S3-IA. Cold: Glacier.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: all data في hot storage، unnecessary cost.

en.why: Messages stored for 30 days average.
en.how: S3 Standard: $23/TB/month. 1500TB × $23 = $35K.
en.tradeoffs: Tiering to Glacier: 80% cheaper for old messages.
en.examples: Hot (7 days): S3. Warm (30 days): S3-IA. Cold: Glacier.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: All data in hot storage, unnecessary cost.

text.ar: Bandwidth: 50B messages × 1KB × 2 (send+receive) = 100TB/day = ~$900K/month
text.en: Bandwidth: 50B messages × 1KB × 2 (send+receive) = 100TB/day = ~$900K/month

ar.why: Egress bandwidth is expensive. $0.09/GB.
ar.how: 100TB/day × 30 days × $0.09 = $270K. With CDN: ~$900K.
ar.tradeoffs: CloudFront/CDN: cheaper egress. Direct: simpler.
ar.examples: AWS egress after CDN: ~$0.085/GB. Still major cost.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: underestimate bandwidth cost، biggest surprise.

en.why: Egress bandwidth is expensive. $0.09/GB.
en.how: 100TB/day × 30 days × $0.09 = $270K. With CDN: ~$900K.
en.tradeoffs: CloudFront/CDN: cheaper egress. Direct: simpler.
en.examples: AWS egress after CDN: ~$0.085/GB. Still major cost.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Underestimate bandwidth cost, biggest surprise.

prompt.ar: إيه الـ security concerns والـ abuse vectors؟
prompt.en: What are the security concerns and abuse vectors?

text.ar: Spam prevention: rate limiting وreported account handling
text.en: Spam prevention: rate limiting and reported account handling

ar.why: Spammers سيستهدفوا الـ chat platform.
ar.how: Rate limit messages per user. ML-based spam detection. Report system.
ar.tradeoffs: Aggressive limits: false positives. Lenient: spam gets through.
ar.examples: Limit: 100 messages/min. Flag accounts با 10+ reports.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: no rate limits، spammers تغرق النظام.

en.why: Spammers will target the chat platform.
en.how: Rate limit messages per user. ML-based spam detection. Report system.
en.tradeoffs: Aggressive limits: false positives. Lenient: spam gets through.
en.examples: Limit: 100 messages/min. Flag accounts with 10+ reports.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: No rate limits, spammers flood the system.

text.ar: Account takeover protection: 2FA، session management، suspicious activity detection
text.en: Account takeover protection: 2FA, session management, suspicious activity detection

ar.why: Account compromise = access to all messages.
ar.how: 2FA mandatory. Single session or multi-device management. Alert on new device.
ar.tradeoffs: More friction for users. بس better security.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: Web sessions require phone scan. Alert on new login.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: weak session management، easy account takeover.

en.why: Account compromise = access to all messages.
en.how: 2FA mandatory. Single session or multi-device management. Alert on new device.
en.tradeoffs: More friction for users. But better security.
en.examples: WhatsApp: Web sessions require phone scan. Alert on new login.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Weak session management, easy account takeover.

text.ar: Content moderation without breaking E2EE
text.en: Content moderation without breaking E2EE

ar.why: Legal requirements vs user privacy.
ar.how: Report-based moderation. Client-side scanning (controversial). Metadata analysis.
ar.tradeoffs: Full E2EE: cannot moderate. Partial: privacy concerns.
ar.examples: WhatsApp: reported messages decrypted by recipient، forwarded to moderators.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: break E2EE for moderation، lose user trust.

en.why: Legal requirements vs user privacy.
en.how: Report-based moderation. Client-side scanning (controversial). Metadata analysis.
en.tradeoffs: Full E2EE: cannot moderate. Partial: privacy concerns.
en.examples: WhatsApp: reported messages decrypted by recipient, forwarded to moderators.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Break E2EE for moderation, lose user trust.

prompt.ar: إيه الـ DR strategy؟ وإيه الـ RPO/RTO؟
prompt.en: What is the DR strategy? What are RPO/RTO?

text.ar: RPO: near-zero لـ messages (async replication)، RTO: < 5 minutes
text.en: RPO: near-zero for messages (async replication), RTO: < 5 minutes

ar.why: Chat: losing messages = unacceptable. Downtime: users will wait.
ar.how: Async replication to standby region. Hot standby for fast failover.
ar.tradeoffs: Sync replication: zero RPO بس high latency. Async: near-zero RPO.
ar.examples: Primary: us-east. Standby: us-west. Replication lag: < 1 sec.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: no async replication، lose minutes of messages in disaster.

en.why: Chat: losing messages = unacceptable. Downtime: users will wait.
en.how: Async replication to standby region. Hot standby for fast failover.
en.tradeoffs: Sync replication: zero RPO but high latency. Async: near-zero RPO.
en.examples: Primary: us-east. Standby: us-west. Replication lag: < 1 sec.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: No async replication, lose minutes of messages in disaster.

text.ar: Multi-region: user affinity لـ home region، failover لـ standby
text.en: Multi-region: user affinity to home region, failover to standby

ar.why: Global users محتاجين low latency. Single region = single point of failure.
ar.how: User assigned to home region. Data replicated to standby. Failover via DNS.
ar.tradeoffs: Cross-region chat is slower. But simpler consistency.
ar.examples: User in Egypt: home = eu-west. Chat with US user: message goes through 2 regions.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: no affinity، data scattered and hard to manage.

en.why: Global users need low latency. Single region = single point of failure.
en.how: User assigned to home region. Data replicated to standby. Failover via DNS.
en.tradeoffs: Cross-region chat is slower. But simpler consistency.
en.examples: User in Egypt: home = eu-west. Chat with US user: message goes through 2 regions.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: No affinity, data scattered and hard to manage.

text.ar: Cross-region message routing: regional gateways
text.en: Cross-region message routing: regional gateways

ar.why: لو sender وrecipient في regions مختلفة، message لازم يعدي.
ar.how: Regional gateway: receives message → routes to correct region → delivers.
ar.tradeoffs: Added latency للـ cross-region. بس necessary.
ar.examples: AWS: 50-150ms inter-region latency. Acceptable.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: direct connection بين regions، complex mesh.

en.why: If sender and recipient in different regions, message must pass through.
en.how: Regional gateway: receives message → routes to correct region → delivers.
en.tradeoffs: Added latency for cross-region. But necessary.
en.examples: AWS: 50-150ms inter-region latency. Acceptable.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Direct connection between regions, complex mesh.

text.ar: Failover: messages stored until delivered، لو region وقع
text.en: Failover: messages stored until delivered, if region fails

ar.why: لو region وقع، messages لازم تستنى.
ar.how: Messages stored in sender region حتى delivery ack. Retry عند failover.
ar.tradeoffs: Longer retention في sender region أثناء الـ outage.
ar.examples: Region down 1 hour → messages queue، deliver عند recovery.
ar.mistakes: خطأ شائع: تعتبر message delivered قبل الـ ack، message lost.

en.why: If region is down, messages must wait.
en.how: Messages stored in sender region until delivery ack. Retry on failover.
en.tradeoffs: Longer retention in sender region during outage.
en.examples: Region down 1 hour → messages queue, deliver on recovery.
en.mistakes: Common mistake: Considering message delivered before ack, message lost.

description.ar: بعد outage قصير، 40M clients بيحاولوا يعملوا reconnect في نفس الوقت. الـ LB والـ WS servers بتسقط تاني. إيه هتعمل؟
description.en: After a brief outage, 40M clients try to reconnect at once. LB and WS servers are falling again. What do you do?

checklist.ar: Connection rate limiting على الـ LB
Scale WS fleet وshed load gracefully
checklist.en: Scale WS fleet and shed load gracefully

description.ar: مشهور انضم لجروب 500 عضو وبيبعت رسائل، بس الـ fan-out بقى لـ millions بسبب shared groups وتكديس. النظام بيتأخر. الحل؟
description.en: A celebrity joined a 500-member group and is messaging, but fan-out exploded to millions via shared groups and backlog. System is lagging. Fix?

checklist.ar: Switch large fan-out لـ read-time / hybrid
checklist.en: Switch large fan-out to read-time / hybrid

checklist.ar: Isolate hot conversations على shards منفصلة
checklist.en: Isolate hot conversations on dedicated shards
Batch push notifications instead of per-message

description.ar: بعد مباراة، ملايين اليوزرز online/offline بسرعة. الـ presence pub/sub بيغرق الـ connections. إيه التخفيف؟
description.en: After a match, millions of users go online/offline rapidly. Presence pub/sub is flooding connections. What is the mitigation?

checklist.ar: Increase TTL وreduce heartbeat frequency مؤقتاً
checklist.en: Increase TTL and reduce heartbeat frequency temporarily

checklist.ar: Degrade presence accuracy أثناء الـ spike
checklist.en: Degrade presence accuracy during the spike

question.ar: Real-time delivery: WebSocket ولا long polling؟
question.en: Real-time delivery: WebSocket or long polling?

expectedNote.ar: WebSocket هو المتوقع لنظام chat بحجم WhatsApp.
expectedNote.en: WebSocket is expected for a WhatsApp-scale chat system.

prosB.ar: أبسط مع الـ proxies والـ firewalls

whenOtherWins.ar: Long polling fallback للشبكات اللي بتمنع WebSocket.
whenOtherWins.en: Long polling as fallback on networks that block WebSocket.

expectedNote.ar: Hybrid شائع: write-time للجروبات الصغيرة، read-time للكبيرة.
expectedNote.en: Hybrid is common: write-time for small groups, read-time for large ones.

prosB.en: Single write, cheaper for huge groups

whenOtherWins.en: Write-time for groups <100, read-time for broadcast/celebrity.

question.ar: Message visibility: strong ولا eventual consistency؟
question.en: Message visibility: strong or eventual consistency?

expectedNote.ar: Chat يتحمل تأخير ثواني؛ الـ availability أهم.
expectedNote.en: Chat can tolerate seconds of delay; availability matters more.

prosA.ar: كل الأجهزة تشوف نفس الترتيب فوراً
prosA.en: All devices see the same order immediately

consB.en: Might briefly see a delayed message

whenOtherWins.ar: Strong consistency أهم في financial/ledger-like messaging.
whenOtherWins.en: Strong consistency matters more for financial/ledger-like messaging.
